gates.name: PostgreSQL capacity tests

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#postgresql-capacity-observation RED: no configured backend observation can report PostgreSQL primary-volume capacity independently; GREEN: disposable normal, low-threshold and unavailable fixtures return the exact status/bytes/threshold/time/error projection through one private read-only view; decisive comparison: each injected condition maps independently, the mount rejects writes, forbidden path/data/credential markers remain absent and cleanup removes task resources; artifact: redacted capacity, topology and marker-scan output.
purpose: Provide one configured read-only PostgreSQL primary-volume capacity observation without exposing storage contents or adding monitoring infrastructure.
success_outcome: The backend can observe PostgreSQL capacity as ok, low or unavailable with current bytes/threshold/time while the volume and internal service stay private and read-only.
anti_goals: Do not expose a filesystem path, data file, credential, database port, Docker socket or monitoring endpoint.
Do not add a metrics agent/store, history, alerting, product capacity target or write access to the PostgreSQL volume.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The primary volume cannot be observed through one configured read-only view in the accepted Compose topology.
Proof would require production mounts/data, Docker API access or a monitoring service.

constraints: Use one configured read-only filesystem view and a statvfs-equivalent observation.
Use disposable Compose resources and synthetic path markers; do not inspect or record data-file content.
Normal, configured-low and unavailable fixtures are safely rerunnable and clean only task-owned resources.
invariants: PostgreSQL remains private and the backend capacity view is read-only.
The result contains only status, nullable bytes, positive threshold, observed_at and bounded error.
No path, credential or mounted data content enters output or logs.
verification_targets: Disposable Compose proof covers normal, configured-low and unavailable observations, effective read-only mount, private ports, marker redaction and cleanup.
